verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships a first-party AI Assistant inside its no-code Connector Builder that prefills and configures fields and sections when you start a new connector, and the Builder lets you develop a connector for syncs inside the workspace, which covers review and ship. The evidence never says the AI works from API documentation, nor which parts (auth, pagination, streams) it drafts. missing for 10: evidence that AI drafts from API documentation input, explicit coverage of auth, pagination and stream generation, hands-on or independent corroboration that drafted connectors work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts a working connector from API documentation — auth, pagination, streams — that I review and ship

citations.quote: When starting a new connector, AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder
